```{=html}
<div class="project-detail" id="projectDetail">
  <div class="detail-panel">
    <button class="close-btn" onclick="closeProject()">✕</button>
    <div id="detailContent"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="project-detail" id="presentationModal">
  <div class="detail-panel" style="width:100vw;height:100vh;max-width:100vw;max-height:100vh;padding:0;border-radius:0;position:relative;">
    <button class="close-btn" onclick="closePresentation()" style="position:fixed;top:20px;right:30px;z-index:9999;">✕</button>
    <iframe src="portfolio-presentation.html" style="width:100%;height:100%;border:none;display:block;" allowfullscreen></iframe>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
const projects = {

  dm1: {
    icon: '💻', type: 'Off-Page SEO', title: 'Trauma Resource Institute',
    tags: ['Audit', 'Analysis', 'SEO'],
    data:      'Brand website was the platform investigated in the audit, using Squarespace and SEMRush analytics.',
    problem:   'How can we strengthen TRI authority and visibility by aligning trauma-related content with high-impact external channels and strategic keyword usage?',
    audience:  'People who are looking for assistance with trauma',
    questions: 'How can we strengthen TRI authority and visibility by aligning trauma-related content with high-impact external channels and strategic keyword usage?',
    impact:    'Increased attention to call to actions, in order to heighten the conversion rate on the TRI website.',
    methods:   'Off-page SEO audit, keyword analysis, backlink review using SEMRush.',
  },

  dm2: {
    icon: '📱', type: 'Mock Partnership', title: 'A Holiday Membership Campaign',
    tags: ['KPIs', 'Call to Action', 'Ongoing Optimization'],
    data:      'No real data used, a mock process',
    problem:   'LA Fitness wanted the group to come up with ideas for a mock membership campaign, specifically for their social media and website.',
    audience:  'Existing members and the buddies they bring with them, especially the buddies signing up for a membership.',
    questions: 'How can LA Fitness convert buddy pass users into paying members during the New Year peak sign-up season?',
    impact:    'Increased membership conversions through targeted social media and website campaigns during peak season.',
    methods:   'Growth strategy, Paid advertising, Ongoing optimization.',
  },

  dm3: {
    icon: '📝', type: 'Skin Tint Survey', title: 'Hidden Label Survey',
    tags: ['Qualtrics', 'Data Analysis'],
    data:      'Convenience sample of 106 respondents with random assignment of products.',
    problem:   'How does packaging design influence consumer perception and purchase decisions for skin tints across luxury vs. non-luxury brands?',
    audience:  '18+ consumers in the United States',
    questions: 'How does packaging design influence consumer perception? Does it impact purchase decisions?',
    impact:    'Insights into how packaging attributes drive purchase intent, informing brand positioning strategy for cosmetics companies.',
    methods:   'Chi-square tests, MANOVA, ANOVA, Tukey Post-Hoc.',
  },

  dm4: {
    icon: '🎯', type: 'Paid Media', title: 'Google Ads Campaign Strategy',
    tags: ['PPC', 'Google Ads', 'CRO'],
    data:      'Google Ads dashboard data, Google Analytics conversion data',
    problem:   'Local service business was spending on ads with no clear ROI visibility or conversion tracking.',
    audience:  'Small business owner / marketing decision maker',
    questions: 'Which keywords and ad groups deliver the lowest cost-per-conversion? How should budget be allocated?',
    impact:    'Improved ROAS and reduced wasted spend through better targeting and negative keyword management.',
    methods:   'Campaign audit, keyword performance analysis, Quality Score optimization, bid strategy analysis.',
  },

};


function openProject(id) {
  const p = projects[id];
  if (!p) return;
  document.getElementById('detailContent').innerHTML = `
    <p style="font-size:0.68rem;letter-spacing:0.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#E8722A;font-weight:400;margin-bottom:0.5rem;">${p.icon} ${p.type}</p>
    <h3>${p.title}</h3>
    <div class="detail-meta">${p.tags.map(t=>`<span class="card-tag">${t}</span>`).join('')}</div>
    <div class="detail-section"><label>Data &amp; Source</label><p>${p.data}</p></div>
    <div class="detail-section"><label>Managerial Problem</label><p>${p.problem}</p></div>
    <div class="detail-section"><label>Target Audience</label><p>${p.audience}</p></div>
    <div class="detail-section"><label>Research Questions / Objectives</label><p>${p.questions}</p></div>
    <div class="detail-section"><label>Expected Business Impact</label><p>${p.impact}</p></div>
    <div class="detail-section"><label>Methods</label><p>${p.methods}</p></div>
  `;
  document.getElementById('projectDetail').classList.add('open');
}

function closeProject() { document.getElementById('projectDetail').classList.remove('open'); }
document.getElementById('projectDetail').addEventListener('click', function(e) { if (e.target === this) closeProject(); });

function openPresentation() { document.getElementById('presentationModal').classList.add('open'); }
function closePresentation() { document.getElementById('presentationModal').classList.remove('open'); }
document.getElementById('presentationModal').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
  if (e.target === this) closePresentation();
});

</script>
```
